name: il.co.experts/professionals
title: המומחים (experts.co.il)
description: Find rated local professionals in Israel: Google rating, availability and sourced prices.

tools.name: search_professionals
tools.description: Find rated professionals in Israel for a service category, optionally near a city. Returns name, city, Google rating and review count, availability (today / tomorrow / from a date), profile URL, and the category's sourced price range. Category and city are Hebrew names (e.g. category "אינסטלטור", city "חיפה").

category.description: Service category in Hebrew, e.g. "חשמלאי", "יועץ משכנתאות", "אדריכל". Synonyms are accepted.

city.description: Optional Israeli city in Hebrew, e.g. "תל אביב".

tools.name: get_professional
tools.description: Details of one professional by id (from search_professionals): Google rating, review count, availability, service area, up to 5 recent public customer reviews, and the category price range.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the service categories available on experts.co.il (Hebrew names and synonyms). Optional text filter.

query.description: Optional Hebrew text to filter by.

tools.name: get_category_prices
tools.description: Sourced price ranges in ILS for a service category in Israel (typical range and per-service ranges). Returns nothing when no verified price data exists.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search for professionals in Israel, e.g. "אינסטלטור בחיפה". Returns a list of results with id, title and url; pass an id to fetch.

query.description: Hebrew free text: a service and optionally a city.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full text of a search result by its id ("pro:<number>" or "category:<slug>").
